measurement_description: The benchmark did not measure any aspects of faith or religion. Its focus was on evaluating Vision-Language Models on open-ended responses across eight general categories: descriptive analysis, inferential reasoning, contextual understanding, emotional and psychological understanding, ethical evaluations, abstract understanding, creative and subjective analysis, and visual aesthetics evaluation.
